component.name: Kurako
component.summary: Experimental Linux build of a cross-platform anime library and player
实验性 Linux 版跨平台本地番剧库与视频播放器

description.p: Kurako organizes and plays local, SMB, and WebDAV anime libraries with Bangumi metadata, subtitle support, and download management.
Kurako 用于整理和播放本地、SMB 与 WebDAV 番剧媒体库，支持 Bangumi 元数据、外挂字幕和下载管理。
